messages:
hana (sales): Kai from Atlas wants a POC with hosted API keys. They need a recommended minimal flow for create -> rotate -> revoke that they can run from their CI.

eric (solutions): Minimal safe flow: 1) call provisioning API to create ephemeral key (one-time client_secret). 2) store secret in a vault (do not log). 3) before expiry, run provision again, update vault, then call revoke on old key. Ensure atomic swap in CI.

eric (solutions): Example create payload: POST /v1/provision/keys {"customer":"atlas","type":"ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400,"scopes":["generation:invoke"] } -> returns {"key_id":...,"client_secret":...} (client_secret shown once).

tara (security): Security rules: TTL default 24h for high-sensitivity POCs, 72h OK for low-risk. Must tag issuance with audit_tag=poc:atlas. Revoke endpoint requires org-admin token. Rotate by create->verify->revoke. No secrets in repo; use HSM-backed vault recommended.

kai (customer): Can our CI do create+revoke in the same pipeline safely? We need a zero-downtime swap for running services.

eric (solutions): Yes: sequence: a) create new key, b) push secret to vault, c) health-check consumers against new secret (one request), d) if OK revoke old key. If health-check fails, keep old key and roll back.

acct-bot: Policy check: issuance_limit=15/hr applied; audit_tag required.

hana (sales): Can you give a compact curl pair for our runbook (create + revoke)? I'll send to Atlas.

eric (solutions): Create (curl):
```
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision/keys" -H "Authorization: Bearer $PROVISION_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"customer":"atlas","type":"ephemeral","ttl_seconds":86400}'
# returns {"key_id":"k_xyz","client_secret":"s_ABC"}
```
Revoke (curl):
```
curl -X DELETE "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/k_xyz" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```

tara (security): Approved: 24h TTL for Atlas, audit_tag=poc:atlas set, vault required for secret storage.

hana (sales): Thanks all — I'll send the short runbook and sample pipeline snippet to Kai. Kai, we'll follow up after you wire the CI. :thumbsup:

kai (customer): Thanks, that helps. We'll test a daily rotate job and report results.
